runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍，未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Took up a prominent position outside leader, not able to finish off the race under top weight, weakened 300M. (Jockey : progressing from Griffin company and may not have been suited with its allotted weight of 135 lbs.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側的前列位置。在負頂磅下未能以勁勢衝刺。三百米處轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎自新馬賽升班角逐，獲配一百三十五磅上陣或不合發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away well, sat 1-1/2L behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, hard ridden after passing 300M, took the lead 200M, kept on very well to the line, won by 3-3/4L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。跑過三百米處後受力策。二百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，以三又四分三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on rail, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off very strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自第一檔起步普通，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能望空。三百米處望空。末段衝刺凌厲，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Moderately away, raced prominently on the middle track, peaked 300M, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘普通，居前列，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W) Commenced well, raced in midfield, 8 lengths or so back turning in, finished off very strongly, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置。入直路時落後約八個馬位。衝刺凌厲，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, angled out 550M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，留居後列，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後四至五個馬位，末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) Average to begin, positioned a length or so back on the middle track, hard ridden from 250M, showed very good response, took the lead 50M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)出閘一般，落後約一個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。自二百五十米處起受力策，對催策反應甚佳。五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Yes Yes Yes out of the Medaglia d'Oro mare Dubrovnik. Horses by the same sire include Glowing Praises and Run Yes Run. He was given three trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He sat not far behind the pace and finished second, beaten by 3-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on September 29. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished third, beaten by 1-1/2Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 30. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: Yes Yes Yes之後，在港同父馬包括「好評如潮」及「東昇鉞」等駒，生母出自「金獎章」(Medaglia d'Oro)。抵港後三次試閘兩次上名。9月29日出試田泥1050米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬3.25個馬位。最近10月30日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.5個馬位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Slow to begin, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Admire Mars out of the Fastnet Rock mare Hembrook. Horses by the same sire include Dashing Mars and Sassphire. He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished eighth, beaten by 10-3/4Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「頌讚火星」(Admire Mars)之後，在港同父馬包括「同利高」及「睿麗人生」，生母出自「燈塔島」(Fastnet Rock)。抵港後試閘兩次。最近11月2日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第八名，落後頭馬10.75個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced in 2nd, 3-3/4L back turning in, showed good response early in straight, peaked on run 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居第二位。入直路時落後三又四分三個馬位。直路初對催策反應良佳。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Pinatubo, who also sired Golden Gunners, out of the Real Impact mare Queen Himiko. He was given five trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second, beaten by 4-3/4Ls, under a hold over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on September 17. In the latest trial, he was taken back and finished seventh, beaten by 4-3/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 30. He's a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「呂宋火山」(Pinatubo)之後，另一匹在港同父馬為「金鎗寶駒」，生母出自「實際影響」(Real Impact)。抵港後五次試閘兩次上名。9月17日出試田泥1050米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下跑第二名，落後頭馬4.75個馬位。最近10月30日出試田泥1200米，起步居後，末段稍騎下跑第七名，落後頭馬4.75個馬位。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Farnan out of the Exceed And Excel mare Escape Artist. Horses by the same sire include Daily Acclaim and Gaudium Magnum. He was given two trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished second, beaten by a neck, under a hold over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished second, beaten by 1-3/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「輝隆」(Farnan)之後，在港同父馬包括「日日賞」及「極歡欣」等駒，生母出自「盡善盡美」(Exceed And Excel)。抵港後兩次試閘全上名。10月23日出試從化草地1000米，早段並頭領放，末段按韁下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。最近11月2日出試從化草地1000米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬1.75個馬位。初出應可交出良好表現。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by King's Legacy out of the Exceed And Excel mare Shiso. Horses by the same sires include Golden Win and Flying Hunter. He was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished seventh, beaten by 10-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「王者事蹟」(King's Legacy)之後，在港同父馬包括「金運齊來」及「威力飛騰」等駒，生母出自「盡善盡美」(Exceed And Excel)。抵港後試閘三次。最近11月2日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第七名，落後頭馬10.25個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W1W) Made contact at start, raced in 3rd, 6 lengths or so back turning in, showed good response in straight, took the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居第三位。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後七十五米未能抗衡頭馬。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Brutal out of the Commands mare Commanding Epic. Horses by the same sire include Super Strong Kid and Without Compare. He was given six trials for one win in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and won by a neck under slight pressure over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on June 5. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fourth, beaten by 3Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 5. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but perhaps he could run well.
formguide.comments_chi: Brutal之後，在港同父馬包括「金金小子」及「凌登」等駒，生母出自「聽命」(Commands)。抵港後六次試閘得一勝。6月5日出試田泥1050米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下以一馬頸位之先勝出。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬三個馬位。不似能一出即勝，惟或可交出不俗表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear, 10 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made reasonable progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，落後約十個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Began well from gate 10, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the stands' rail early, dropped towards rear gradually after passing 600M, failed to make any progress final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;自第十檔出閘迅速，早段落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。跑過六百米處後墮居後列。最後三百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped on jumping, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the stands' rail, peaked near 400M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時發生碰撞，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走外欄。接近四百米處時未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leading pair, challenged 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。三百米處展開挑戰。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, well placed and every chance from 400m out, unable to quicken, gave ground final 100m.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起居好位，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段未能加速，最後一百米墮退。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Ridden forward after moderate start to within 2L of pace in 3rd or 4th, switched off rail for a run shortly after straightening but unable to quicken to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居第三或第四位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。入直路後不久移離內欄以取位，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Prominent early from a low draw, gradually drifted backward to midfield approaching first turn, baulked for a run just inside the 400M, quickened well to hit the front over 100M out only to be collared final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 自內檔出閘，早段居前列。趨近首個彎位時逐漸墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處後受困。末段加速良佳，一百米處取得領先，僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Moderate start, gradually recovered to midfield in 8th or 7th on rail, improved to 6th some 4L back on home bend, fought on under pressure to reach 2nd 100M out but without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步一般，其後逐漸恢復走勢，居中間第七或第八位，走內欄。直路彎推進至第六位，落後約四個馬位。在催策下力拼，一百米處進佔第二位，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) Average to begin, raced in 2nd, 3/4L back turning in, hard ridden from 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 出閘一般，居第二位。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。自三百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, ridden before settling in 10th on rail saving ground turning into straight, made up good ground under pressure despite inconvenienced over 50M out, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，在催策下居第十位，走內欄。入直路時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下追前甚多，五十米處受妨礙。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Settled midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, responded nicely when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。對催策反應良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the inside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure to hold position 600m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Sluggish start, pushed up to race in rear of mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 300m, in contention and every chance final 150m, bumped by rival late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，受推策上前，居中間之後位置。最後三百米在催策下保持走勢。最後一百五十米持續拼鬥，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段被對手碰撞。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W4W) Moderately away, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘普通，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Crowded start, raced at tail, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居包尾位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W1W) Taken back from gate 10, raced at rear, 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W1W) 自第十檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後七至八個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Dropped back on jumping from draw 14, raced as the back-marker throughout, had big task in hand 400M but couldn't make any progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自第十四檔躍出，墮後。沿途居包尾位置。四百米處落後甚遠，但未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure home straight, in third place briefly over 100m out, outpaced final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路上受催策，保持走勢。一百米處一度居第三位。最後五十米速度不及前列馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Keen under restraint in mid-field, short-lived headway over 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在受約束下搶口，居中間位置。二百米處一度追前。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, raced keenly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。搶口。末段對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off some weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W3W) Sat on pace on the rail, traveled nicely, closed off well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W3W) 居前列，走內欄。走勢良佳。以佳勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced behind midfield on rail, 3 lengths back on turn, no clear run early in straight, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎落後三個馬位。直路早段未能望空，其後追前頗多，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Sat at the rear, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Bumped start, taken back to race at rear on the outside, last turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide better than midfield, a length back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, 2 wide on turn, angled out after passing 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時被觸碰，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。直路彎走第二疊，跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Wide in mid-field, pushed along bend, struggling and held from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎受推策。自三百米處起掙扎上前，未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Average to begin, tracked leaders on the inside, saved ground on turn, hit the front near 300M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。接近三百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped exiting stalls, ridden along from stalls to across, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，受催策以切入。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈疲態，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, commenced move out wide 600m out, under pressure 400m out, stuck to task, checked close home and lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處開始發力，走外疊。四百米處受催策，持續力拼。接近終點時勒避，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Sat handy 2 wide, raced keenly, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居前列，走第二疊。搶口。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W6W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W6W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, angled out 500M, showed limited response early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field with cover, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走勢暢順。以佳勢追前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, held up in the Straight, stayed on once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路上受困。望空後保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled behind midfield, gave ground inside150M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。一百五十米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Settled on pace on the rail, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 10. raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W4W) Raced wide towards rear, passed a few rivals late, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居後列，走外疊。末段超越數匹對手。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to lead, pushed along 500m out, headed top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 出閘後受催策，取得領先。五百米處受推策。直路初被超越。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Settled handy, finished off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居前列。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, stayed on well but unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段保持佳勢，但未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled fairly, weakened passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢一般。跑過二百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Pushed along from stalls to lead, challenged by rivals 500m out, headed by runner-up 200m out, fought back to lead again 50m out, just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘後受推策以取得領先。五百米處受對手挑戰。二百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。五十米處反先該駒再次取得領先，險勝而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走外疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leader, pushed along to chase leader 600m out, stayed on well and just held on in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領放馬。六百米處受推策以追趕領放馬。保持佳勢，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2 lengths or so back, angled out 400M, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。直路早段未能再加速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Dipped shortly after the start, raced behind midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久將頭低俯，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Taken back from gate 8, positioned 3 wide with cover, 4 lengths or so back, there to turn, made some headway in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自第八檔出閘後留後，落後約四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Sat near the rear on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke fairly and settled midfield the rail, stayed at the same pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內欄。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Waited with in rear, checked 350m out, passed a few tiring rivals, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處勒避。超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 400M, taken wide in straight and made good progress to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Taken back from gate 11, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 400M, 6 lengths or so back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自第十一檔起步後留居後列，走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Rear of mid-field, short of room bend, headway once clear over 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎空位不足。三百米處望空後隨即上前。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, cleared near 250M, finished off very strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路初未能望空。接近二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺凌厲，跑獲亞軍，僅以頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初移出外疊以望空。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled behind midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway 400m out, unable to sustain and flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處上前。未能保持走勢，最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along to race in rear early stages, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，早段在推策下居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field with cover, some headway on bend, sustained headway early in home straight to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。直路早段持續追前，二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sat towards rear on the rail, traveled smoothly, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居後列，走內欄，走勢暢順。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, made steady ground late (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段穩步上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Mid division, had to wait for run turning into home straight, short of room 400m out to 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。四百米處至一百米處空位不足。際遇欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) In rear after crowded at start, had to wait for run top of home straight, switched wide for clear run 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列。直路初須等待空位出現。一百米處移出外疊以望空。敗在欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Held up last, race keenly throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留居包尾位置。沿途搶口。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W6W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W6W) 留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Began well from gate 1, sat a length behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide after passing 600M, same margin back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。跑過六百米處後走第三疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 7 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, in rear, struggled to hold position from 600m out, well held from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，被拋離，居後列。自六百米處起難以保持位置。自三百米處起遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W) Across from widest draw to press leader, under pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策。末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped out of stalls, three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞。居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, under pressure from the 500M, weakened soon after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起受催策，其後瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on rail, 2 wide turning in, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, failed to make any progress thereafter.
Roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走內欄。入直路時走第二疊。直路初未能望空。其後未能追前。
患有喘鳴症。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時須等待空位出現。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (3W5W) Out in line, raced behind midfield on outer, 4 lengths back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初對催策毫無反應。最後三百米轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 300M, failed to make any progress thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。跑過三百米處後望空，其後毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Bumped and lost balance out of stalls, tracked leaders against rail, switched for clear run 500m out, dropped away quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘時被碰撞及失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside early, moved closer after passing 1250M, positioned 3 wide, a length or so back in the middle stages, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間位置，走外疊。跑過一千二百五十米處後追近。中段落後約一個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W4W) Began awkwardly and bumped, raced in midfield on the inside, steadied near 700M, angled out approaching 650M, 3 to 4 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W4W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。接近七百米處時收慢。趨近六百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時走第三至第四疊。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Waited with in rear from wide draw, short of room top of home straight, stayed on once clear 300m out, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，居後列，留力候上。直路初空位不足。三百米處望空後隨即保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 12, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 350M, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching 150M, finished off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。末段衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能威脅頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, a bit closer on turn, 2 wide after passing 500M, no clear run early in straight, kept on evenly thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。跑過五百米處後走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，其後保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled towards rear, lay in inside 200M, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。最後二百米內閃。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W) Crowded and bumped leaving stalls, mid division, under pressure 550m out, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時受擠迫，發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策。未能望空直至二百米處。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, chased leaders into home straight, stayed on, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。保持走勢。未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Taken back to race at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along 500m out, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。五百米處受推策。直路初一度發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 700m out, ran on well in home straight, lost out only narrowly in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處移離內欄。直路上以佳勢上前。在多駒幾乎齊過終點下僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, bumped 250m out, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百五十米處發生碰撞。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off well to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。衝刺良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leader throughout, outpaced by that rival 300m out, stayed on, closed gap final 100m but never getting there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 沿途跟隨領放馬。三百米處被該駒拋離。保持走勢，最後一百米追近，但從未能追及頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, traveled fairly, limited response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢一般。末段對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Moderately away from a tricky draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, peaked 500M, weakened thereafter.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 自第九檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。五百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced on outside of leader, outpaced and unable to stay with that rival 350m out, no extra late and lost third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。三百五十米處被拋離，未能跟上該駒。末段再無餘力，失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, made minor ground on the inside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段在內疊略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Crowded and bumped at start, settled in mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Bumped start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, unable to pick up for pressure form 350m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自三百五十米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米迅速轉弱。
患有喘鳴症。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, traveled well, ran on strongly, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。走勢良佳。以勁勢上前，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Blundered shortly after the start, sat behind midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 起步後不久失蹄，居中間之後位置。末段難以望空，衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, keen early, under pressure to challenge leader 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬，早段搶口。五百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Sat on pace, raced wide, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W4W) Sat at the rear 3 wide, closed off okay from the rear. (Barrier manners unacceptable, must BT)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段自後列衝刺尚可。（閘廂行為難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Held up from wide draw, tailed-off most of the way, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留後。大部分途程居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 3 wide in midfield, carried wider turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時移出更外疊。直路早段對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier and soon taken back to last few, became last on straightening despite saving ground on rail, soon detached.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，瞬即留居最後數位之內。入直路時雖走內欄節省腳程，但居包尾位置。瞬即被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W) Taken back from wide draw, last and pushed along into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W) 自外檔出閘後留後。入直路時居包尾位置，受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Held up last, ridden along middle stages to catch up to main body, eased once well held in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 留居包尾位置。中段受催策以追上主馬群。直路上遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind the leader on the inside, peaked on turn, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居領放馬之後，走內疊。直路彎未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Out with rest, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground to turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked pace, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, not enough room near 200M, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，與他駒互相觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時空位不足。其後追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced towards rear on the inside early, angled out after entering the back straight, 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，早段居後列，走內疊。進入對面直路後向外移出。入直路時落後七至八個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield early, 3 wide after entering the back straight, moved closer after passing 900M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 出閘普通，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。進入對面直路後走第三疊。跑過九百米處後追近。入直路時落後約兩個馬位，直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Jumped only fairly, raced 3 wide behind midfield, hard ridden after passing 550M, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。跑過五百五十米處後受力策。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, hit the front 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W2W) Slightly slow out from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back in the middle stages, angled out early in straight, finished off well to take 2nd, nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘稍慢，居中間位置，走內疊。中段落後三個馬位。直路早段向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位，直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Average to begin, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, hard ridden from 600M but only showed limited response, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。自六百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬一般。直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, under pressure 550m to maintain position, headed early in home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。五百五十米處受催策以保持位置。直路初被超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, raced wide throughout, commenced move out wide 600m out, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W5W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，沿途走外疊。六百米處開始上前，走外疊。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Prominent early but soon ridden and unable to hold position, towards rear by halfway, well held early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 早段居前列，但瞬即受催策，未能保持位置。半程時居後列。直路初落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Settled midfield, limited response when asked.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。末段對催策反應平平。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven along 500m out, stayed on well to close on winner late but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策。保持佳勢，末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初空位不足，未能望空直至二百米處。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊，最後二百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled only fairly, gave ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。二百米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, rail position in rear, dropped to last pair into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，居後列，走內欄。入直路時墮居最後兩位之內。未能望空直至二百五十米處。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W4W4W6W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W4W4W6W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W3W2W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W3W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，失去平衡。居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位，直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3-1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三又四分一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled in mid-field, switched for clear run 300m out, tended to hang in final 200m, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米傾向內閃。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W3W) Jumped well from gate 10, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, showed some response early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段對催策略有反應。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, taken wide in straight, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上移出外疊。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 400M, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰。居中間之後位置，走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Three wide in rear, pushed along wide in home straight, forced to steady 250m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。直路上受推策，走外疊。二百五十米處被迫收慢。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 200m but lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 1100M, 3 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, made no impression in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。跑過千一米處後略為追近，直路彎落後三個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W4W) Slightly slow out and bumped, recovered to race in midfield, commenced move 700M, a length or so back turning in, kept on well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W4W) 出閘稍慢，被碰撞，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。七百米處開始上前。入直路時落後約一個馬位。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded briefly at start, in rear, stayed on final 300m, never going pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時一度受擠迫，居後列。最後三百米保持走勢。從未能加速追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, no clear run from 250M to 100M, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。二百五十米處至一百米處之間未能望空。其後追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run early in home straight, clear run final 200m, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路早段須等待空位出現。最後二百米望空，保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, made good ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。二百米處追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W3W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, 3 wide turning in, showed good response early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W3W3W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處未能再加速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped with them, showed no early speed, raced at tail, 8 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，缺乏前速，居包尾位置。入直路時落後八個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路早段未能望空。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, taken wider 500m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。五百米處被帶出較外疊。直路初受催策，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the inside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Hampered shortly after start, raced in rear, commenced move out wide 600m out, sustained headway early in home straight, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 起步後不久受阻礙，居後列。六百米處開始上前，走外疊。直路早段持續上前。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W4W) Away with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 lengths or so back, wider turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W3W6W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at tail throughout, never a factor. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W3W6W) 自第九檔出閘後留後，沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W3W4W) Held up, under pressure long way out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W3W4W) 留後。距離終點尚遠時已受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, minor progress made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, kept on evenly inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。最後二百米保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W3W3W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly, settled behind midfield, raced wide and without cover throughout, very limited when asked.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W3W3W4W5W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。對催策反應頗為有限。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Taken back from gate 11, raced 2 wide at rear, 4 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W6W) Out in line, raced 3 wide towards rear, carried wider from 550M, very wide into straight, made no progress in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W6W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，走第三疊。自五百五十米處起被帶出更外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, waited with in rear, short of room early in home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居後列，留力候上。直路早段空位不足。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。居中間之前位置。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, challenged leader 500m out, ran on well to lead narrowly 200m out, crossed by winner 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。五百米處挑戰領放馬。以佳勢上前，二百米處以短距離領先。五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, ran on well final 200m but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。最後二百米走勢良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Crowded at start, settled in mid-field, checked 1400m out, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run 300m out, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。千四米處勒避。入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處望空。最後二百米走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W5W) Taken back to race 3 wide with cover towards rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W5W) 留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Rear of mid-field, limited response to pressure home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。直路上對催策反應平平。 毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded at start, settled in mid-field, pushed along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。五百米處受推策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed by winner top of home straight, dropped away quickly, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑，在領放下受追迫。直路初被頭馬超越。迅速墮退，落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, switched out entering the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, raced at tail, still last turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off well to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置。入直路時仍居包尾位置。直路上移出外疊。衝刺良佳。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W3W5W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W3W5W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，落後約四個馬位，走外疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W3W3W4W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, angled out 500M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W3W3W4W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Towards rear, brief forward move early in home straight, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。直路初一度發力上前。瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, hard ridden from 450M, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自四百五十米處起受力策。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W5W5W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure 550m out, stayed on steadily to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W5W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。五百五十米處受催策。保持穩勢，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on very well in straight, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持甚佳走勢，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure to hold position final bend, crowded and checked 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎在催策下保持位置。二百米處受擠迫及勒避，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W5W) Settled midfield, raced keenly early, lay in under pressure, made good ground inside 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W5W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。在催策下內閃。最後二百五十米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W2W) Sat off pace on the rail, angled out in the Straight, closed off nicely, just no match to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W2W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，僅未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Not the quickest out, sat worse than midfield on the rail, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘並非最快，居中間之後位置，走內欄。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W4W) Reserved in midfield 6Ls off the steady pace, switched to 3-wide making the turn for home, quickened up impressively from 400M, led mid-straight before powering away to win by big margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W4W) 留居中間位置，落後步速平穩的領放馬六個馬位。轉直路彎時移至第三疊。自四百米處起加速凌厲。直路中段取得領先。其後帶離對手，大勝而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, stayed on well, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。保持佳勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in last few, obtained a clear run 300M out, ran on well inside final 200M past beaten runners closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居最後數位之內。三百米處望空。最後二百米以佳勢上前。末段超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, switched out at the Turn, made steady progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。直路彎向外移出。在催策下以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat worse than midfield, 4-1/2L back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W4W4W) Crowded at start, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W4W4W) 起步時受擠迫，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W4W) Towards rear, wide and lost ground final bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居後列。直路彎走外疊及失地。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W4W5W) Waited with towards rear, headway widest final bend, strong run to lead over 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W4W5W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎上前，走最外疊。衝刺強勁，一百米處取得領先。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W5W) Raced very widest without cover throughout, some headway on bend, lost touch final 300m, left behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W5W) 沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。最後三百米未能跟上對手，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Awkward start, recovered to track pace, switched to outside of leader 300m out, edged in behind that rival when giving chase 150m out, ran on well once straightened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，其後恢復走勢，跟隨領放馬。三百米處移至領放馬外側。一百五十米處在追趕之際在該對手之後切入。入直路後保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked pace, had to switch off rail to chase leaders 400m out, blocked against rail 300m out when trying to challenge, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處須移離內欄以追趕領先馬匹。三百米處在嘗試展開挑戰之際沿欄受困。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Raced prominently, challenged 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居前列。二百米處展開挑戰。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速及被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Led on the rail, traveled smoothly, shifted out under pressure, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 沿欄領放，走勢暢順。在催策下向外斜跑，已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield, lay in in the Home Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置。直路上內閃。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat behind the lead, traveled strongly, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬之後，走勢強勁。保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Chased leader, traveled okay, slightly weakened inside 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。走勢不俗。最後一百五十米略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Chased leader along the inside in a race being run very slowly in the middle stages, lacked winner's acceleration passing 400M, just kept to the task in the run home for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 追趕領放馬，走內疊，賽事中段步速非常緩慢。跑過四百米處時加速力不及頭馬。末段僅保持走勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, there to turn, no clear run and made contact early in straight, cleared 300M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空，與對手互相觸碰。三百米處望空，其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly and settled near the rear, pushed wide after 600M before running home fairly in the straight. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。過了六百米處後受推策，走外疊。直路上衝刺一般。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, stuck to inside rail, lacked pace to challenge but stayed on late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後向內移入，持續走內欄。速度不足以展開挑戰，但末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide behind midfield early, 2 wide after entering the back straight, 6 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，早段居中間之後位置，走第三疊。進入對面直路後走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W2W3W) Settled worse than midfield, failed to respond and weakened (Must BT).
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。對催策毫無反應及轉弱。（必須試閘及格。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Towards rear of mid-field, stayed on amongst horses final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。最後一百五十米在馬匹之間保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved ground on the turn, closed off nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。衝刺良佳，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, restrained to race in mid-division, held up passing 400M, couldn't quicken enough final 300M and was always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，受約束居中間位置。跑過四百米處時受困。最後三百米加速力不足，一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W4W6W) Sat towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, made some ground under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W4W6W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段在鞭策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded at start from a wide barrier settling in last few, saved ground turning in for home but did not find much room early in straight, kept on under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔起步時受擠迫，居最後數位之內。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程，但直路早段空位不足。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away settling at the back, saved ground on rail turning in for home, ran past beaten horses in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。入直路時走內欄節省腳程。末段超越已洩氣潰敗的馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced in second half of the field along the 3-path, driven 500M but couldn't quicken, never able to challenge. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後半馬群中，走第三疊。五百米處受催策但未能加速。從未能作出挑戰。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, outpaced and left behind final 500m, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。未能跟上步速，最後五百米被拋離。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, recovered to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，恢復走勢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running near the 200M, ran on fairly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。接近二百米處時難以望空。末段走勢一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Ridden along to race prominently, raced wide throughout, stayed on well in home straight, lost out narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 在催策下居前列，沿途走外疊。直路上保持佳勢。以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure when short of room and forced to switch around 200m out, stayed on after, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，在催策下保持同速，空位不足。約二百米處被迫向外移出。其後保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide in front of midfield, raced greenly in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路上走勢稚嫩。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Travelled in midfield 3-wide with cover, slightly worse around home bend and given reminders entering straight, kept on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉直路彎時稍為墮後，入直路時受鞭策。在催策下保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Led from barrier 6 and quickened up end of the back straight, found no extra to sustain his run and soon headed final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第六檔出閘後領放。對面直路末段加速上前。後勁不繼，未能保持走勢。一百米處瞬即被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W) Led, traveled smoothly, kept on nicely to score (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W) 領放。走勢暢順。保持佳勢，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, weakened and faded in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。直路上轉弱及力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, 2 wide from 900M, 6 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。自九百米起走第二疊。中段落後六個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, headed over 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。三百米處被超越。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Sat in the last few, soon unable to keep up with the field 500m out, failed to run on in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居最後數位之內。五百米處瞬即未能跟上馬群。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Sat towards rear, always rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 沿途居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Raced 3 wide no cover off midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled comfortably, switched out rounding the Turn, closed off nicely (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W2W) Held up from wide draw, pushed along 500m out, stayed on final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W2W) 自外檔出閘，留後。五百米處受推策。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W6W) Dropped in from wide draw, ridden to try and make ground wide on bend, stayed on late, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。直路彎在催策下嘗試推進，沿外疊追前。末段保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover behind midfield, never involved. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W3W2W2W) In touch, rushed up to race outside of leader after 600m, unable to match that rival 300m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W3W2W2W) 緊隨領放馬。過了六百米處後快速上前，居領放馬外側。三百米處不敵該駒，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, unable to further quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上未能進一步加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Mid-field, wide final bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Pressed forward from a poor draw to be prominent and wide without cover home bend, folded up quickly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，居前列。直路彎走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W2W2W) Sat on pace, angled out from 1500M and led passing 1200M, gave ground quickly in the Straight (Disappointing Performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W2W2W) 居前列。自千五米處起向外移出，跑過千二米處時帶頭。直路上迅速墮退。（表現令人失望。必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out 550M, took the lead 300M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。三百米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W) Wide early, taken forward and raced prominently, ridden to lead 200m out, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 早段走外疊，受催策上前，居前列。二百米處在催策下取得領先。保持佳勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) In touch, kicked nicely at the centre part of the track and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 緊隨領放馬。在跑道中央加速良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, kept on.
Rider's whip got knocked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。保持走勢。
騎師的馬鞭被擊中脫手。
runnerrecords.incident_chi: 騎師的馬鞭被擊中脫手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover in front of midfield, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leader, weakened from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。自直路初起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 500M, 5 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W3W) From wide draw taken back to last, pressed along home turn and had 7Ls to make up on leader 400M, took time to get going and commenced to finish off well final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。直路彎受催策。四百米處落後領放馬七個馬位。加速需時。最後二百米開始以不俗走勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Sat prominent on the girth of the leader, maintained the same gear to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列，緊隨領放馬。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W4W) Sat behind mid, raced wide and without cover from the 800M, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，自八百米處起走外疊，沒有遮擋。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield, 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back turning in, kept on evenly in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, under pressure to challenge over 200m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處在催策下展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W3W) Mid-division, headway halfway as leading trio came back to field, improved to lead 150m out, headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置。半程時上前，追及被馬群追上的領先三駒。推進，一百五十米處取得領先。過終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-3/4L turning in, kept on very well in straight, easily scored. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，從容獲勝。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat at the rear, hung in and never seriously tested. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。內閃。從未能真正施為。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W4W) Average to begin, sat worse than midfield one off, took a while to wind up and worked to the line well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W4W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。對催策反應較慢。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W4W) Sat towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on, nothing extra final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。保持走勢。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W4W) Sat behind mid, angled out entering the Straight, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時向外移出。走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W2W) Restrained from wide draw and dropped out in rear, still in last pair entering home straight, stayed on final 150m, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後受約束，墮居後列。入直路時仍居最後兩位之內。最後一百五十米保持走勢。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat against the fence midfield, briefly blocked for a run, stayed on ok, something further would suit.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。一度受困而未能望空。末段保持尚可走勢。增程角逐或更合發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Towards rear, under pressure when short of room 400m out, some late headway, never dangerous.
