runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。四百米處在受催策之際空位不足。末段略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W6W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, traveled fairly, raced very wide throughout, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W6W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。走勢一般。沿途走大外疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W4W) Jumped fairly, given a reserved ride near the rear, still 8Ls to make up 400M, closed off moderately to claim 5th but was never likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W4W) 出閘一般，居後列，留力候上。四百米處仍落後八個馬位。衝刺普通，取得第五名，但從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, slightly improved on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為推進上前。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled handy, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
(Lame in right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat midfield on the outside rail, made minor headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，走外欄。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Held a handy position 2Ls on settling , driven along 400M but the final effort was just moderate, out of contention from 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，落後兩個馬位。四百米處受催策，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。自二百米處起再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jostled at start, gradually settled well back, commenced move inside the 400M and ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時受擠碰，逐漸遙居於後。四百米處開始上前，走勢良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sluggish start, mid division, ridden along 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步緩慢，居中間位置。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但未能增速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat one off the rail alongside the leader, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居領放馬旁側，走外欄第二疊。末段保持勁勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) Sat near the rear near center, held up until 350M, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)居後列，靠近跑道中央競跑。受困直至三百五十米處。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked pace, under pressure 400m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領放馬。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat handy 3 from the outside rail, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列，走外欄第四疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat midfield 3 from the outside rail, ran on without threatening the top 2.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，走外欄第四疊。持續上前，未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Russian Revolution out of the Stratum mare Eiffel Tower. Horses by the same sire include Glory Elite and Candlelight Dinner. This fellow had fourteen starts for three wins (a maiden handicap over 1200m, a handicap over 1200m and a handicap over 1300m) and four placings. He was given three trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished third, beaten by a neck, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he raced handily and won by a neck, under a hold over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 5. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「俄式變革」(Russian Revolution)之後，在港同父馬包括「輝煌精英」及「燭光晚餐」等駒，生母出自「高層次」(Stratum)。來港前在澳洲十四戰得三勝四位，頭馬包括一場1200米從未勝出馬讓磅賽、一場1200米讓磅賽，及一場1300米讓賽。抵港後三次試閘兩次上名。10月23日出試從化草地1000米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下以一馬頸位之先勝出。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W) From draw 11 obliged to race very wide outside leaders throughout, was left without a finishing effort in the final straight and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，沿途須在領先馬匹外側走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力及轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out at start, raced better than midfield on the outside in the early stages, took the lead approaching 800M, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on very strongly in straight, won by 2-1/2L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑。早段居中間之前位置，走外疊。趨近八百米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路上保持勁勢，以兩個半馬位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Box seat, under pressure to hold position from 600m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。自六百米處起受催策以保持位置。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Up with early pace then eased to a trailing position behind leaders, fought on one paced early straight before overrun by rivals closing stages. (Jockey - instructed to go forward as it did in a barrier trial.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 早段跟上步速，其後收慢，居領先馬匹之後有遮擋的位置。直路早段保持同速，末段被對手超越。（騎師表示，他獲指示讓坐騎如試閘時般上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat on pace 2 from the stands' rail, made no ground. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列，走外欄第三疊。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) Moderately away, positioned a length behind the leader on the stands' side, no clear run until approaching 200M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。未能望空直至趨近二百米處。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Crowded at start, made headway from midfield early to join race leader 600M out, shared pace until finding no extra inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 起步時受擠迫。早段自中間位置追前，六百米處與領放馬並跑。並排領先，直至最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Always well behind, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿途遙居於後。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded after the start, soon moved forward and vied for the lead, couldn't go on mid-straight and weakened. (Jockey - disadvantaged when pressured in the lead.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後受擠迫，瞬即上前爭奪領先。直路中段無以為繼，轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在領放下受追迫而不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Pressed forward from the widest draw to share the pace racing very wide, obtained 2-wide position in front coming onto first turn 600M out, hung on under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自最外檔出閘後受催策上前，並排領先，走大外疊。六百米處開始轉首個彎位時取得領先，走第二疊。直路上在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced 3 wide towards rear, wider turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

formguide.comments_eng: British PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Starspangledbanner out of the Cape Cross mare Dancer Cross. Horses by the same sire include Beauty Waves and Drombeg Banner. This fellow had one start for one win (a 3yo+ maiden over 1200m) in Ireland. He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished fifth, beaten by 2-1/2Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 27. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「花旗」(Starspangledbanner)之後，在港同父馬包括「美麗第一」及「飛鷹翱翔」等駒，生母出自「十字灣角」(Cape Cross)。來港前在愛爾蘭一出一捷，頭馬為一場1200米三歲及以上從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘兩次。最近10月27日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第五名，落後頭馬2.5個馬位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Positioned towards the rear after jumping fairly, checked near 600M, 7Ls to make up top of straight, closed off best to take 3rd close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居後列。接近六百米處時勒避。直路初落後七個馬位。末段衝刺最佳，接近終點時取得第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped with the rest and gradually settled towards the rear, copped a check near the 600M, raced wide on turn 400M out, ran on comfortably to the finish under top weight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，逐漸居後列。接近六百米處時勒避。四百米處轉彎時走外疊。在負頂磅下輕鬆上前掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W3W) Slow to being, sat worse than midfield on the rail, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off well, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) In rear after slow start, steadied off heels on occasions, good headway up rail home straight, improving to chase leaders when running out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，數度收慢避開他駒後蹄。直路上沿欄追前甚多。末段推進上前，追趕領先馬匹，但空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Prominent, keen early, pushed along 400m out to chase leaders, looked like winner 300m out but weakened final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，早段搶口。四百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。三百米處甚具勝望，但最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W2W) Prominent early stages, drifted some 3L off the pace about 900M out, in similar position in 5th rounding home bend swinging wide into straight, kept on at the one pace without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W2W) 早段居前列。約九百米處墮退，落後領放馬約三個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若的第五位。入直路時移出外疊。保持同速，未能構成威脅。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Brutal out of the Toronado mare Mrs Beckham. Horses by the same sire include Super Strong Kid and Without Compare. This fellow had one start for one win (a 3yo maiden over 1000m) in Australia. He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished seventh, beaten by 6-1/2Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 5. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: Brutal之後，在港同父馬包括「金金小子」及「凌登」等駒，生母出自「豪華房車」(Toronado)。來港前在澳洲一出一捷，頭馬為一場1000米三歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘兩次。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第七名，落後頭馬6.5個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Hello Youmzain out of the More Than Ready mare Waterfalls. Horses by the same sire include Rapid Phantom and Brilliant Winner. This fellow had eight starts for one win (a maiden over 1300m on Synthetic) and two placings. He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished seventh, beaten by 7Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 27. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「哈囉躍升」(Hello Youmzain)之後，在港同父馬包括「極速神影」及「活力輝煌」等駒，生母出自「超妥當」(More Than Ready)。來港前在紐西蘭八戰得一勝兩位，頭馬為一場1300米膠沙地從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘兩次。最近10月27日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第七名，落後頭馬七個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 5-year-old gelding, by Kingman out of the American Post mare Chica Loca. Horses by the same sire include Kingman Reef and Fast Speed. This fellow had six starts for two wins (a maiden handicap over 1300m and a handicap over 1500m) and two placings. He was given three trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third, beaten by 2Ls, under pressure over 1050m AWT in Conghua on October 15. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and finished fourth, beaten by 11-1/2Ls, under pressure over 1050m AWT in Conghua on October 29. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「皇僕」(Kingman)之後，在港同父馬包括「澄心知遇」及「勁步速」等駒，生母出自American Post。來港前在澳洲六戰得兩勝兩位，頭馬包括一場1300米從未勝出馬讓磅賽，及一場1500米讓賽。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。10月15日出試從化泥地1050米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。最近10月29日出試從化泥地1050米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬11.5個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Made contact at start and unbalanced, raced behind midfield on the middle track, 5 lengths or so back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時與對手互相觸碰，失去平衡。居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。中段落後約五個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Crowded on jumping, stayed in touch with leaders just 2Ls away, couldn't quicken enough when the race got serious 400M, only held ground at best in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;躍出時受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹，僅落後兩個馬位。四百米處馬群加速時加速力不足。末段表現最佳時僅能保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Never far off from a middle draw, came under pressure to challenge inside final 300M holding every chance, only to be outsprinted close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自中檔出閘後從未遠離領先馬匹。最後三百米受催策以展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; From draw 14 went forward to be racing with leaders, responded well up the stand's rail final 200M, just denied.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第十四檔出閘，上前與領先馬匹並跑。最後二百米沿外欄競跑時對催策反應良佳。僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent, improved to lead 500m out, pressed on 350m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列。推進上前，五百米處取得領先。三百五十米處受追迫。一百米處被頭馬超越。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 50M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W) 受催策上前帶頭。保持走勢，最後五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat on pace on the stands' rail, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，走外欄。走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Dispute lead, nothing extra final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;爭奪領先。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the middle track, 3 lengths back at 400M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，在跑道中央競跑。四百米處落後三個馬位。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Went forward from draw 1 to be vying for the lead, quickly beaten top of straight and weakened to finish last. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後上前爭奪領先。直路初迅速洩氣，轉弱，包尾而回。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sent forward and keen, pressed leader and clear of rest, weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 受催策上前，搶口，追迫領放馬及帶離餘駒。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, 4 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，落後約四個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled well back, produced late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;遙居於後。末段略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, ran green in home straight, flattened out final 200m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路上走勢稚嫩。最後二百米洩氣。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Not hurried early stages, towards the rear 6Ls off the pace mid-race, struggled to pick up turning for home. Well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段未受催策。中段居後列，落後領放馬六個馬位。轉直路彎時難以加速。所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled towards rear on rail, shifted out away from fading runners over 600M out, one-paced in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列，走內欄。六百米處向外移出避開力竭的對手。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Chased leader in joint 2nd or 3rd on rail, came under pressure to hold place rounding home bend, dropped out of contention shortly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 追趕領放馬，並列第二或第三位，走內欄。轉直路彎時在催策下保持位置。入直路後不久墮退，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled in the back half of the field 6Ls off leader, couldn't go on passing 300M, dropped out rapidly well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬六個馬位。跑過三百米處時未能上前。迅速墮退，所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, found rail near 900M, saved ground on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened 300M, finished tailed out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初對催策毫無反應。三百米處轉弱。包尾大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W2W4W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, quickened early in home straight to lead 100m out, weakened quickly final 50m.
Substantial blood in trachea.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W2W4W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路早段加速，一百米處取得領先。最後五十米迅速轉弱。
氣管內有很多血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, short of room early in home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路初空位不足。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths back on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 500M, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Raced in touch, short of room entering home straight (briefly) and again 200m out when trying to improve, stayed on after switched.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 緊隨領放馬。入直路時一度空位不足。二百米處在嘗試推進之際再度空位不足。轉換跑線後保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W5W) Outpaced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 居後列，未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 550m out, stayed on well to close on leaders late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百五十米處向外移出取位。末段保持佳勢，追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well from inside draw, obtained a position in midfield, 4Ls to make up 400M, stayed on steadily to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自最內檔出閘迅速，居中間位置。四百米處落後四個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 500M, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W7W) Raced in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W7W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W1W2W3W) Sat last, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Made running, kicked over two lengths clear 300m out, closed down final 100m but never looked like being caught.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 領放。三百米處加速帶離逾兩個馬位。最後一百米被追近，但從未看似會被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 100M.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢，一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，最後一百米轉弱。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, ridden and kicked two lengths clear top of home straight, ran on well and unchallenged from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。直路初受催策，加速帶離兩個馬位。自該處起走勢良佳，未受挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began smartly, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。轉入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵頭馬，僅以短距離見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W2W) Moderately away from gate 13, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, peaked 200M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 自第十三檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W) Always thereabouts, hit the front shortly after straightening and led until overhauled by fast-finishing winner 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W) 沿途居啣接位置。入直路後不久取得領先，直至一百五十米處被衝刺強勁的頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W1W) Sat towards rear, held up near the 250M, not fully tested (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居後列。接近二百五十米處時受困。未能全力施為。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W7W) Began well from gate 11, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W7W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Away in line, restrained to race in midfield along the fence, responded only fairly in the straight. Never reached contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。直路上對催策反應僅屬一般。從未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival on turn, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎與對手並排領先。二百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, driven along 400m out, weakened quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受催策。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Prominent early, 3-wide without cover rounding first bend, just over 2L off the pace in 4th in back straight, gave ground under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 早段居前列。首次轉彎時走第三疊，沒有遮擋。對面直路上居第四位，落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。最後二百米在催策下墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W5W) Mid-field, made effort wide off final bend, every chance from 200m out, no extra closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W5W) 居中間位置。直路彎發力，走外疊。自二百米處起已獲機會盡展所長，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W5W) Waited with towards rear, followed winner through from 400m out, unable to match pace of that rival but stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W5W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起跟隨頭馬上前。末段未能跟上頭馬，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W1W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, stayed on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段保持佳勢，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, still travelling smoothly 400m out, effort and headway, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處走勢仍然暢順。其後發力追前。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Slow to begin, waited with in rear, didn't get best of runs first half of home straight, stayed on at the one pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，留力候上。直路前半段未能完全望空，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Began well and tracked the pace on outside, kept up with leader early straight and was still in contention passing 200M, run ended final stages and weakened to 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路初保持跟隨領放馬，跑過二百米處時仍具爭逐機會。末段無以為繼，轉弱，跑獲第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W3W3W) Sat rear, commenced to improve passing the 600M, one pace to the line (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W3W3W) 居後列。跑過六百米處時開始上前。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, moved closer after passing 600M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
(Jockey dropped whip at 250M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後追近。入直路時落後約兩個馬位，直路上保持穩勢。
（於二百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於二百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well and was sent forward, led, kept on until weakened final 100M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。保持走勢直至最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W6W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W6W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W1W1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, traveled nicely, kept on to hold 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 在力策下領放，走勢良佳。保持走勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat off pace 2 wide, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier travelling one back 3-wide without cover early stages, made swift headway inside the 1000M to lead rounding home bend, found no extra and swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，早段落後一個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處迅速上前，轉直路彎時取得領先。最後一百米再無餘力及被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Wide in mid-field, headway 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處追前。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sluggish start, shifted in and bumped out of stalls, in rear, good headway 500m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘緩慢，向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居後列。五百米處追前甚多，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in last place after slow start, passed a few rivals final 150m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。最後一百五十米超越數匹對手。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W1W1W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W1W1W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W2W3W) Sat last, made no ground. (See Incident Report)
(Multi-limb lameness.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（多肢不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Mustered no early pace and settled 3rd last about 15Ls or so off the leader 600m out, peeled out widest turning in for home, stormed home to score with sufficient speed in the race.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 欠缺前速，居尾三位置，六百米處落後領放馬約十五個馬位。入直路時移出最外疊。賽事步速頗快，末段衝刺凌厲，取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W1W) Waited with in rear, severely checked 400m out when trying to improve, lost all chance and allowed to coast home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處在嘗試推進之際大力勒避。其後再無爭逐機會，獲許順其自然地競跑至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat last, able to pick off weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居包尾位置。末段超越已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards rear, failed to respond (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Slowly away, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Slowly away, positioned 5 lengths behind the leader on rail, wider turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘緩慢，落後領放馬五個馬位，走內欄。入直路時走較外疊，末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in rear of mid-field, clear run up rail from 400m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自四百米處起沿欄望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat at the rear, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W6W) Slow to begin, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W6W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走外疊。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Settled worse than midfield, switched out at the Turn, made good ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎向外移出。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W3W5W) Taken back to race at rear, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, a bit closer turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
Rider dropped his whip near 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W3W5W) 留居後列。中段落後約六個馬位。入直路時略為追近。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。
騎師於接近三百米處時跌掉馬鞭。
runnerrecords.incident_chi: 騎師於接近三百米處時跌掉馬鞭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along over 400m out, no headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策，未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W5W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Towards rear, struggling and left well behind from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列。自直路初起掙扎上前，落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Very slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, a bit closer in the middle stages, angled out after passing 500M, made some progress early in straight, no clear run inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 出閘十分緩慢，居包尾位置，走內疊。中段略為追近。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段略為追前。最後一百米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應平平，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, commenced move 500M, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處開始上前。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, forward move to chase leaders 400m out, lacked pace to challenge, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處上前追趕領先馬匹。速度不足以展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, navigated through traffic in the Straight, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上在馬群中推進上前。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Slow to jump, tailed-off most of the way, came from well back and made some inroads, but couldn't get into it.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，大部分途程居包尾位置。自遙遙落後的位置略為追前，但未能上前爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段僅保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W5W) Very slowly away losing considerable ground, trailed the field most of the way and the widest into straight, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W5W) 出閘十分緩慢，失地甚多，大部分途程尾隨馬群。入直路時走最外疊。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, pushed along when checked briefly 500m out, struggling and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。五百米處受推策，一度勒避。最後三百米掙扎上前及被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。欠缺速度以展開挑戰。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly, ended up racing near last, had some work to do 400M but responded only fairly to pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居接近包尾位置。四百米處落後頗遠，但對催策反應僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Soon taken back from a wide barrier, trailed the field from about 1300M out, made modest progress past well-beaten horses in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘，瞬即留後。自約千三米處起尾隨馬群。直路上略為追前，超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled okay, made steady progress inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢尚可。最後二百米穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped well, sat on pace, minor ground made when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，跟前競跑。在催策下略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Held up in last few, went wide for a run into straight but baulked until 250M out, kept on well in closing stages without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 留居最後數位之內。入直路時移出外疊取位，但受困直至二百五十米處。末段保持佳勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace until no clear run final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後五個馬位。其後保持同速，最後五十米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden 500m out, switched for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。直路初轉換跑線以望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run until final 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。未能望空直至一百五十米處，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Travelled 3-wide without cover in prominent positions, weakened shortly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路後不久轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased the leader, gave ground quickly passing 200M, not much impression made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。跑過二百米處時迅速墮退。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride towards the rear but failed to run on under top weight. Never in the picture. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未受催策，居後列，留力候上，但在負頂磅下未能追前。從未有力一爭。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 550m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Blundered shortly after start, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead near 950M, challenged by rival turning in, headed early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久失蹄，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百五十米處時取得領先。轉入直路時受對手挑戰。直路初被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in 3rd, some 4L off the fast pace rounding home bend, kept on at the same pace early in straight but swamped for a placing inside final 80M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居第三位。轉直路彎時落後步速甚快的領放馬約四個馬位。直路早段保持同速，但最後八十米被後上馬匹超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield but trapped wide, sent forward after passing 1000M, 2nd in the middle stages, kept on well early in straight, peaked 250M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，但走外疊。跑過一千米處後在催策下上前。中段居第二位。直路早段保持佳勢。二百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted out abruptly out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, driven along 600m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時急促向外斜跑，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, mid division, bumped 250m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘時被碰撞，居中間位置。二百五十米處發生碰撞。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 6-1/2L back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W) 自最外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W6W) Soon taken well back from a poor draw, commenced move when carried wide 600M out, widest into straight and only ran past a couple of well-beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W6W) 自大外檔出閘後瞬即遙居後列。六百米處被帶出外疊時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。末段僅能超越兩匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W4W) Sat in front of the rear, made some ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W4W) 居後列。略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Taken back from wide draw, settled in last 6Ls off the pace, had plenty to make up top of the straight, brought wide and attacked the line strongly. Pleasing return.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。直路初仍落後頗遠，末段移出外疊及以勁勢衝刺。復出戰表現可喜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W2W1W) Jumped awkwardly, held up towards the rear 8Ls off leader early stages, remained in similar position 600M, made steady headway from 450M to claim 2nd late. No threat to runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W2W1W) 出閘笨拙，早段留居後列，落後領放馬八個馬位。六百米處仍居相若位置。自四百五十米處起穩步追前。末段跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅遙遙領先的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Settled in 3rd on rail just over 1L back, kept on in straight until finding no extra closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 居第三位，落後稍逾一個馬位，走內欄。直路上保持走勢。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Went forward tracking leaders, handy enough early straight but gave in easily and was weak from 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 上前跟隨領先馬匹。直路初居前列，但迅速墮退。自二百米處起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Away well enough, up with early pace before easing back to sit behind leaders, challenged strongly for the lead from 250M, led nearing 50M but was caught by winner last stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘頗佳，早段跟上步速，其後收慢留居領先馬匹之後。自二百五十米處起以勁勢上前挑戰，爭奪領先。接近五十米處時取得領先，但最後一步被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier to share the pace 2-wide, drifted slightly backward rounding home bend before hitting the front just inside the 400M, kicked over 1L clear 200M out only to be swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，並排領先，走第二疊。轉直路彎時略為墮退。跑過四百米處後取得領先。二百米處加速帶離逾一個馬位，僅於最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, short of room against rail top of home straight, checked 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。直路初走內欄，空位不足。二百米處勒避。再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, taken widest into home straight, ran on well to challenge 200m out, tired closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走最外疊。二百米處以佳勢追前以展開挑戰。末段呈疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Broke well from a wide barrier and soon taken some 2L back in 6th 3-wide without cover, drifted 3L off the lead when pace quickened home bend, weakened into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 自外檔出閘迅速，瞬即留後約兩個馬位，居第六位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎賽事步速加快時墮後，落後領放馬三個馬位。入直路時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Sat behind midfield, minor progress made when asked.
Lost left front plate.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;居中間之後位置。受催策時略為追前。
失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W) Settled rear, switched out rounding the turn, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Ridden forward to within 2L of pace 2-wide in 4th, travelled keenly on heels of leaders from between the 1100M and 900M, drifted slightly backward to 5th approaching final turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前，居第四位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。千一米處至九百米處之間緊隨領先馬匹，搶口。趨近直路彎時略為墮居第五位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。末段保持穩勢，但未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast into stride, took the early lead, headed near 950M, 2nd on turn, retook the lead early in straight, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段取得領先。接近九百五十米處時被超越。直路彎居第二位。直路初再度取得領先。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled about 6L off the pace in joint 4th 2-wide, in similar position into straight, fought on steadily without threatening .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 並列第四位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時居相若位置。末段持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W2W) Held up in close-up 2nd, commenced move home bend and hit the front over 200M out, hung on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W2W) 留居接近的第二位。直路彎開始上前。二百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, well placed into home straight, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced prominently on the inside, 1/4L back turning in, kept on well to take 2nd, always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居前列，走內疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Caught wide early from draw 10 before obtaining a prominent spot outside leader 700M out, fought hard in the straight vying for the lead, kept on well to the line only beaten narrowly by first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘，早段走外疊。七百米處佔取領放馬外側的前列位置。直路上力拼，爭奪領先。末段保持佳勢，僅以短距離之差不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leading pair, impeded briefly 200m out when trying to make effort, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處嘗試發力時一度受阻。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 350m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。三百五十米處加速。末段以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Chased leader, didn't travel with much fluency, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走勢欠順。直路初受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Broke well from the one draw, gradually dropped to last few in 8th despite niggled at, hugged rail turning for home, baulked for a run between 200 and 50M, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，儘管受催策，但逐漸墮居最後數位之內的第八位。轉直路彎時走內欄。二百米處至五十米處之間受困。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Bumped at the start, switched off to race in detached last 8-9Ls off the pace, had plenty to do 300M but ran past beaten horses only. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置，遙遙落後領放馬八至九個馬位。三百米處仍落後頗遠，但末段僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along final bend, challenged up rail from 200m out, tight for room and bumped 150m out, ran on well to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。一百五十米處受緊迫及發生碰撞。以佳勢上前，過終點時險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began well before easing back to race in midfield, lay in home straight and proved difficult to ride under 7lb claimer, did best work late to claim 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，收慢留居中間位置。直路上內閃，在獲減七磅的騎師胯下難以策騎。末段表現最佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W1W) Gradually taken back from the widest draw, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W1W) 自最外檔出閘後逐漸留後。從未見具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Close up early, dropped towards rear approaching the 1000M bend, remained in a similar position to home straight, fought on steadily under pressure despite a tight run just inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段緊隨領放馬。趨近一千米處彎位時墮居後列。直路前仍居相若位置。儘管於跑過二百米處後緊迫競跑，但在催策下持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Began moderately, soon recovered to rear of midfield in 7th some 4L off the pace middle stages, tight between runners in similar position into straight, unable to quicken to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 起步普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居中間第七位。中段落後領放馬約四個馬位。入直路時居相若位置，在馬匹之間受緊迫。末段未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Waited with in rear, briefly hampered 1000m out, tight for room early in home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。一千米處一度受阻礙。直路早段受緊迫。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 留居後列，落後約六個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Began only fairly, settled towards the rear of the main group 4Ls off the pace, responded moderately final 300M, was making some progress on leaders but couldn't be ridden out late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居主馬群後列，落後領放馬四個馬位。最後三百米對催策反應普通，略為追近領先馬匹，但末段未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, towards rear, had to wait for run between 400m out and 300m out, stayed on, nearly got up for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。四百米處至三百米處之間須等待空位出現。保持穩勢，幾乎跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out 450M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders out wide, stayed in contention until no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。保持爭逐機會，直至最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced in 2nd, challenged the leader turning in, took the lead 400M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時挑戰領放馬。四百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點。輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Pressed leader, good headway to lead top of home straight, pressed on 300m out, kicked 3 lengths clear 200m out, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初以佳勢上前，取得領先。三百米處受追迫。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily, briefly hampered close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持穩勢，接近終點時一度受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, under pressure top of home straight, headed 300m out, dropped away quickly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初受催策。三百米處被超越。最後一百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat outside the leader, gave ground final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field with cover, pushed along widest into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear along the inside, 5Ls to make up 400M but couldn't muster the pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。四百米處落後五個馬位，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W5W) Out in line, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, commenced move approaching 400M, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。趨近四百米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled handy on the rail, checked near 350M, not much impression made. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居前列，走內欄。接近三百五十米處時勒避。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) From draw 1 stayed close enough behind leaders, held up for clear running 400M to 200M but the finishing response was only mild over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空，末段對催策反應僅屬普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W4W) Jumped well from draw 9, caught racing 3-wide in a position ahead of midfield throughout, kept battling in the straight and narrowly missed 3rd. No threat to first two however.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，沿途居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路上持續力拼，僅失季軍，但未能威脅前兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stumbled leaving stalls, mid division, under pressure 550m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時失蹄，居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden top of home straight, one paced under pressure, just missed third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初受催策。在催策下保持同速。僅失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, chased leader, strong run to lead 300m out, kicked 3 lengths clear 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，追趕領放馬。走勢強勁，三百米處取得領先。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。拋離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped on terms from draw 1, reserved in midfield on settling, held up for clear running from 400m to 200M before finishing off well. Not ridden out close home when racing tight. Could have finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔與對手同步躍出，留居中間位置。四百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空。其後衝刺良佳。接近終點緊迫競跑時未能被力策。本應有望跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away in line, settled down midfield 4Ls off the pace, into clear running 350M, stayed on fairly well to go 3rd near line. Not reach first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，落後領放馬四個馬位。三百五十米處望空。保持不俗走勢，接近終點時進佔第三位，但未能追上頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Disputed led, challenged by rivals top of home straight, headed 250m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 爭奪領先。直路初受對手挑戰。二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W2W4W) Began fairly and remained in rear, commenced move home bend swinging widest into straight, ran on well down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W2W4W) 起步一般，居後列。直路彎開始上前。入直路時移出最外疊。在跑道中央以佳勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last on the rail, made some headway on the inside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居尾列，走內欄。末段沿內疊略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) In rear after sluggish start, unable to hold position from 500m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。自五百米處起未能保持位置。洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders against rail, good headway middle stages, strong run to lead 150m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與他駒互相碰撞。緊隨領先馬匹，走內欄。中段追前甚多。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 100M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。末段保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) Settled in rear of mid-field, switched towards centre of course for clear run 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)居中間之後位置。三百米處移向跑道中央以望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Outpaced early stages, ended up near last 6-7Ls off leader, ran past beaten horses only over final 400M. Never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 早段未能跟上步速，居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。最後四百米僅能超越已洩氣的對手。從未構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。最後二百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, crowded middle stages, under pressure 500m out, well held from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。中段受擠迫。五百米處受催策。自三百米處起遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced prominently behind leader, failed to run on passing 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬之後的前列位置。跑過三百米處時未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Crowded on jumping, raced 3 wide in midfield early, 2 wide from 750M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 躍出時受擠迫。早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自七百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Away awkwardly and lost ground, settled back in the field, last turning home, failed to run on under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。轉直路彎時居包尾位置。其後在催策下未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Away with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Tracked leaders, switched for clear run top of home straight, ran on well final 200m and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米以佳勢追前，僅以短距離見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; From the stand-side draw stayed close enough to leaders, lay in final 500M, kept on well under top weight to take 2nd but safely held by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自最外檔出閘，保持緊隨領先馬匹。最後五百米內閃。在負頂磅下保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 4 lengths turning in, kicked clear early in straight, kept on very well, easily scored, very impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四個馬位。直路早段加速帶離。末段保持甚佳走勢，輕鬆掄元，表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。保持甚佳走勢至終點。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, effort 500m out to chase leaders, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處發力追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat on pace 2 off the stands' rail, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列，走外欄第三疊。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat near the rear, made some headway late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居後列。末段略為追前。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Zousain out of the Artie Schiller mare Divine Chills. Horses by the same sire include Salon S and Papaya Brose. He was given seven trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He sat midfield after jumping slowly and finished second, beaten by 3Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on August 31. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished sixth, beaten by 3-1/2Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 30. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「蘇醒」(Zousain)之後，在港同父馬包括「極上紗瓏」及「禾道豐」等駒，生母出自Artie Schiller。抵港後七次試閘兩次上名。8月31日出試從化草地1000米，起步緩慢，早段居中，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬三個馬位。最近10月30日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第六名，落後頭馬3.5個馬位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Ole Kirk out of the Medaglia d'Oro mare Plaque. Horses by the same sire include Full Of Fortune and Gallant Design. He was given four trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and finished second, beaten by 1-3/4Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on September 18. In the latest trial, he raced handily after jumping awkwardly and finished fourth, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 23. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「童夢奇才」(Ole Kirk)之後，在港同父馬包括「開心滿滿」及「創寶駒」等駒，生母出自「金獎章」(Medaglia d'Oro)。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。9月18日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬1.75個馬位。最近10月23日出試從化草地1200米，起步笨拙，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。初出應可交出良好表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 250M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空。二百五十米處望空。末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W6W) From a wide draw dropped back to near the rear early stages, brought widest 500M from home, came with a big run from well back to get into the placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W6W) 自外檔出閘，早段留居後列。五百米處移出最外疊。自遙遙落後的位置大幅追前，進佔季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the stands' rail, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外欄。最後四百米超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Crowded shortly after the start, raced rear division of mid-field 3 wide with cover, finished off just fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Tracked leader, three wide, effort over 300m out, no extra and lost ground final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。三百米處發力上前。最後二百五十米再無餘力，墮退。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Pierata out of the Sebring mare Vivid Fortress. Horses by the same sire include Top Dragon and Amazing Partners. He was given three trials for two wins in Hong Kong. He was taken back and won by a neck, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 2. In the latest trial, he was taken back and won by a head, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He looks a runner of real interest here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「比樂達」(Pierata)之後，在港同父馬包括「喜尊龍」及「活力拍檔」等駒，生母出自「識奔」(Sebring)。抵港後三次試閘得兩勝。10月2日出試田泥1200米，起步居後，末段稍騎下以一馬頸位之先勝出。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，起步居後，末段力策下以一馬頭位之先勝出。預計初出會有一定走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled nicely, kept on to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 在催策下取得領先。走勢良佳。保持走勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Sluggish start, showed great speed to lead, headed 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，展現甚快前速領放。四百米處被超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders, short of room in home straight until 100m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路上空位不足直至一百米處，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Prominent briefly from a wide barrier but soon taken well back approaching first bend, produced good impression under pressure in home straight, made no further impression inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘，一度居前列，但趨近首個彎位時瞬即留後，遙居後列。直路上在催策下追前甚多。一百米處再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) Tracked leaders towards centre of course, under pressure 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)跟隨領先馬匹，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon took up running on rail after moderate start, led until headed shortly after straightening, folded up quickly inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，瞬即取得領先，走內欄。領放，直至入直路後不久被超越。最後二百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W) Tracked leading pair, challenged briefly 300m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。三百米處一度展開挑戰。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 100M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。一百米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace, unable to quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Shifted out at start and made contact, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked on run 400M, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時向外斜跑及發生觸碰，落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。四百米處未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Held up in rear, never going pace to get competitive in home straight, ran out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 留居後列。直路上從未能加速以爭勝。末段空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards rear, limited response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後固守內疊。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sluggish start, rail position throughout, ridden on bend to chase leaders, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢。沿途走內欄。直路彎受催策，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走大外疊。未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground dropping to the rear, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，失地，墮居後列。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, unable to obtain clear run until approaching final 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。未能望空直至趨近最後一百米，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, positioned 2 wide, 1-1/2L back, there to turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，落後一個半馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well, positioned a length behind the leader on the stands' side, hard ridden from 300M, peaked approaching 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。自三百米處起受力策。趨近一百五十米處時未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with the field and sat prominent, fought on gamely when asked for an effort.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居前列。在催策下奮勇力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Caught 4 wide near midfield, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第四疊。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Led, weakened from the 150M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 領放。自一百五十米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made running, headed 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;帶頭。一百五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Driven along from stalls to lead 700m out, kicked 300m out, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘後受催策。七百米處取得領先。三百米處加速。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat midfield 2 off the stand's rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，走外欄第三疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Began well from a wide barrier to be with leaders racing wide, gradually shifted backward from the 1000M to midfield home bend remaining very wide, dropped away quickly after straightening.
made a respiratory noise.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居領先馬群中，走外疊。自一千米處起逐漸墮居中間位置。直路彎仍走大外疊。入直路後迅速墮退。
發出呼吸聲。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat off midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced behind midfield on the inside, difficult to settle throughout, 3 lengths or so back turning in, unable to obtain clear run until approaching 150M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。沿途難以穩定走勢。入直路時落後約三個馬位。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on very well to the line and scored. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步出閘。受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。保持甚佳走勢至終點，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。受催策時保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, taken wider 600m out, briefly hampered 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處被帶出較外疊。四百米處一度受阻礙。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Sat handy, raced wide, one pace to the line (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 居前列，走外疊。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, ran on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Slightly slow out and made contact shortly after start, positioned a length or so back, 2 away from the stands' rail, no clear run until approaching final 150M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘稍慢，其後不久與對手互相觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on rail, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, 8 lengths or so back turning in, taken wide in straight and made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上移出外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W) Dropped back from draw 11 and adopted a rearward position 6-7L on settling, held up 400M-300M before coming home nicely from well back to take 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W) 自第十一檔出閘，墮居後列，落後六至七個馬位。四百米處至三百米處之間受困。末段以佳勢衝刺，自落後甚遠的位置追前，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, wider after passing 800M, very wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居後列，走第二疊。跑過八百米處後走更外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From draw 3 obtained a midfield position along the fence, driven along 400M but only showed limited response. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策，但反應僅屬平平。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped exiting stalls, tracked leaders, under pressure to chase leaders 600m out, stayed on well, lost second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。其後保持佳勢。接近終點時失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, found rail 550M, no daylight early in straight, made minor progress after passing 250M, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處移入內欄。直路早段未能望空。跑過二百五十米處後略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Bumped exiting stalls, mid division, pushed along wide 500m out, short-lived challenge top of home straight, stayed on for pressure final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處受推策，走外疊。直路初一度發力挑戰。二百米處在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Tracked leader, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, stayed on well and headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢。接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W2W) Prominent on outside of leader, quickened to lead 300m out, headed by winner 50m out and no extra, lost second on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W2W) 居領放馬外側的前列位置。加速上前，三百米處取得領先。五十米處被頭馬超越，再無餘力。終點線上失去亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, short of room top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初空位不足。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sluggish start, dropped in from wide draw, travelling okay top of home straight but still in rear, pushed along, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔起步緩慢，移入內疊。直路初走勢尚可，但仍居後列。末段受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace, wide throughout, weakened final 400m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬。沿途走外疊。最後四百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began well from a wide draw, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, across to track leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, moved smoothly into contention 300m out, strong run to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，切入以跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。三百米處順勢上前挑戰。走勢強勁，過終點時僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W) Made contact at start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, a bit closer in the middle stages, finished off very strongly to take a place, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居後列，走外疊。中段略為追近。末段衝刺凌厲，跑獲季軍，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in rear of midfield, commenced move upon straightening, ran on well under pressure to reach 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時開始上前。其後在催策下以佳勢上前，末段進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W3W) Raced in touch, smooth headway into contention 300m out, chased leader from there, on top final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處以暢順走勢上前，躋身爭勝行列。自該處起追趕領放馬。最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W) From draw 11 positioned close to the pace but caught wide no cover throughout, kept on soundly in the straight to finish a respectable 3rd despite the tough journey.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，緊隨領放馬，但沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。儘管際遇欠佳，但直路上仍保持不俗走勢，取得季軍，表現可嘉。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Settled in 4th about 2L off the pace, commenced move between runners entering home straight but unable to quicken under pressure throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居第四位，落後領放馬約兩個馬位。入直路時在馬匹之間開始發力，但沿途在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway onto heels of leaders bend, one paced under pressure from 300m out.
