runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前緊隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Away well and tracked leader in a steadily run race, in the right place to strike top of final straight but lacked the turn of foot required, no extra and gave way final 200M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，跟隨步速平穩的領放馬。直路初居好位，但欠缺展開挑戰所需的加速力。最後二百米再無餘力，墮退。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Raced in touch, under pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策。末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Dropped steadily to last few in back straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 對面直路上逐漸墮後，居最後數位之內，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, pushed along 300m out, stuck to task but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受推策。持續力拼，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (5W4W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the outside, last turning in, failed to make any progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(5W4W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, ran green under pressure and steadied briefly 200m out, ran on well despite edging left, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。在催策下走勢稚嫩。二百米處一度收慢。儘管外閃，但走勢良佳。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, eased and switched 200m out, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。二百米處收慢及轉換跑線。最後二百米以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, good headway on bend, sustained headway early in home straight to challenge leaders, no extra close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎追前甚多。直路初持續上前挑戰領先馬匹。接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat at the rear 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, ridden along 550m out, well held from 250m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。五百五十米處受催策。自二百五十米處起遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, swung wide on the turn, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路彎移出外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Began well enough, raced keenly early stages and ended up settling outside the lead, held 2nd spot from 500M to 200M and had no extra late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘不俗，早段搶口，其後居領放馬外側。自五百米處起至二百米處保持居第二位。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W4W) Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W4W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 500M, no clear run early in straight, found daylight 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自五百米處起走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，二百米處望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped back from wide draw, settled near the rear and 6Ls off leader 400M, made some progress and wasn't beaten far at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居後列。四百米處落後領放馬六個馬位。末段略為追前，過終點時所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Sat three wide in mid-field, got first run on winner when quickening through to lead 200m out, headed late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。先於頭馬加速上前，二百米處取得領先。末段被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Broke fairly, settled slightly worse than midfield on the rail, no daylight until the last 100M, stayed on fairly well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。未能望空直至一百米處。其後保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled near the rear 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and slowly away, in rear, minor headway late, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及緩慢，居後列。末段略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) From wide draw given a waiting ride towards the rear 3-wide, had 6Ls to make up 400M, closed off fastest and not far behind the minor placegetters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘，留力待上，居後列，走第三疊。四百米處落後六個馬位。末段衝刺最快，落後入位馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。入直路後持續走內疊，略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W3W) Caught wide early stages, elected to stride forward to obtain a position closer to the rail, moved up to 2nd top of final straight, couldn't go with winner passing 300M. Held on well for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W3W) 早段走外疊，主動展步上前，佔取較接近內欄的位置。直路初進佔第二位。跑過三百米處時未能與頭馬一起上前。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Mid-field, stayed on steadily final 300m, got up for second on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。最後三百米保持穩勢。終點線上進佔亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride towards the rear 3-wide , ran past beaten rivals in the straight for a midfield finish. (Jockey - raced greenly throughout.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 早段未受催策，居後列，留力候上，走第三疊。直路上超越數匹已洩氣的對手，居中間位置過終點。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢稚嫩。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Wide in mid-field, lost position entering home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時失位。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began awkwardly and lost ground, recovered to race 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，恢復走勢後落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked on run approaching 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。趨近一百米處時未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began from a wide barrier, took up running after first 100M and rails run 900M out onto first turn, steadied up the pace rounding home bend, led until swamped when no extra inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘。跑了一百米後進佔領先位置。九百米處首次轉彎時走內欄。轉直路彎時減慢步速。末段領放，直至最後五十米再無餘力，被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Slowly away, wide towards rear, hung left halfway, very wide turning into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走外疊。半程時外閃。入直路時走大外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat on pace, weakened inside 150M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Taken back towards the tail of the field and raced keenly throughout the early stages, lacked a strong turn of foot on straightening, made some progress without threatening leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 留居馬群尾列，早段沿途搶口。入直路時未能以勁勢加速上前。末段略為追前，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Unbalanced at start and soon dropped to last few, commenced move rounding home bend going wide for a run into straight, ran on to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時失去平衡，瞬即墮居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時開始發力，入直路時移出外疊取位。追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W2W) From draw 14 moved up to track leader, pressed along 500M to be challenging for the lead, peaked on its run 200M, couldn't go on. (Trainer - instructed jockey to go forward from wide barrier.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W2W) 自第十四檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬。五百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。二百米處未能再增速，無以為繼。（練馬師指示騎師讓自大外檔出閘的此駒上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Raced in touch, keen mid-race, stuck on rail and had to wait for run until 300m out, picked up well to challenge, found only winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。沿欄受困，須等待空位出現直至三百米處。末段以佳勢加速以展開挑戰。僅不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Sat handy, raced keenly early, traveled wide, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居前列。早段搶口。走外疊。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat just behind the leaders 2 wide, limited response in the Straight.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置，走第二疊。直路上對催策反應平平。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to give chase 300m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。三百米處在催策下展開追趕。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, good headway from 300m out, stayed on well closing stages, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起以佳勢上前。末段保持佳勢，但未能追及頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 10 lengths back in the middle stages, still 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。中段落後十個馬位。入直路時仍落後七至八個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slow to begin, recovered to race in midfield along the fence, lacked the finishing kick to challenge leaders, only held ground final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置，走內欄。未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。最後二百米僅能保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat towards the rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled one-out-one-back within 2L of pace, came to challenge under pressure over 450M out holding every chance early in straight until finding no extra 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居第二疊第二位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。四百五十米處在催策下展開挑戰。直路早段一度甚具爭勝機會，直至一百米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W4W) Slow to begin, settled towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W4W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W1W1W1W) Sped forward crossing to the lead, slowed down the pace one in front, headed near 300M and couldn't sustain run final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 加速上前，切入領放，隨即減慢步速。接近三百米處時被超越，末段無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (6W4W1W1W) From draw 12 caught wide no cover when going forward first turn, reached the lead 1100M and took them along at a slightly slow pace, headed mid-straight, faded late but managed to hold on for 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(6W4W1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘。首個彎位上前，走外疊，沒有遮擋。千一米處取得領先，以偏慢步速領放。直路中段被超越。末段力竭，但保住第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, pressed by rivals to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。率先加速，直路初領先。受對手追迫至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in, bumped and lost balance out of stalls, tracked pace out wide, dropped away quickly top of home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，被碰撞及失去平衡，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路初迅速墮退。遙遙落後時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, briefly impeded 500m out, unable to pick up for pressure from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處一度受阻礙。自三百米處起受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W1W3W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W1W3W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置。走勢暢順。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第十三檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, found rail near 1150M, shared lead on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。接近一千一百五十米處時移入內欄。直路彎並排領先。直路早段保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速及被超越，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Broke well from the one draw gradually settled just over 3L off the pace, came under pressure to challenge rounding home bend sharing 3rd briefly into straight, unable to make any further impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，逐漸落後領放馬稍逾三個馬位。轉直路彎時在催策下展開挑戰。入直路時一度並列第三位。末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W4W) Obtained a handy position just ahead of midfield, close enough to the leaders home turn before driven out to take the lead near 200M, held on well from 2nd and 3rd late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W4W) 居中間稍前的好位。直路彎落後領先馬匹不遠。其後受力策，接近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，力拒亞軍及季軍馬匹獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Soon took up running taking advantage of the one draw, set steady pace until joined 700M out, re-gained 1L break on straightening only to be denied 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 把握自第一檔出閘的優勢，瞬即取得領先。以平穩步速領放，七百米處被追上。入直路時重奪領先位置，帶離一個馬位。僅於最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 500m out, outpaced and left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。最後二百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W1W2W) Raced in rear after checked 1500m out, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, tight for room 150m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W1W2W) 千五米處勒避，其後居後列。二百米處前未能望空。一百五十米處受緊迫。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Outpaced early stages and soon detached from the field, dropped out of contention alarmingly from midway. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未能跟上步速，瞬即被馬群拋離。自中段起急劇墮退，再無爭勝機會。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, taken wider 900m out, shifted right in home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。九百米處被帶出更外疊。直路上向內斜跑。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W3W) Went forward under 10lb claimer and held the lead first turn, settled in 2nd from 1100M, fought hard to stay in contention early straight before weakening 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W3W) 在獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎下上前，首個彎位取得領先。自千一米處起居第二位。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden early in home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W5W) Settled behind midfield 3-wide, pace very slow in the first half of the race, couldn't improve position when driven along home turn, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。賽事前半段步速非常緩慢，直路彎受催策時未能追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Waited with in rear, pushed along against rail 500m out, rail position throughout, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。五百米處受推策，走內欄。沿途走內欄。末段未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Tracked leaders out wide with cover, good headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，有遮擋。直路彎以佳勢追前。直路上持續追前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) From draw 2 stayed close to the pace early on before drifting back to race in midfield middle stages, ran home well final 300M for 3rd beaten only 0.5L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，早段居接近領放馬的位置。中段墮居中間位置。最後三百米衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，僅負半個馬位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W5W) Settled in rear of mid-field, good headway on bend, switched widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 300m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W5W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎以佳勢上前。入直路時移出最外疊。最後三百米走勢強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, followed winner through 200m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W1W1W) 沿欄居中間位置。入直路時須等待空位出現。二百米處跟隨頭馬上前。走勢良佳，僅負短距離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Average to begin, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 起步普通，居中間之前位置，走外疊，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Keen in wide position, quickly left behind from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 搶口，走外疊。自四百米處起迅速被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, good headway final bend to press leaders, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前甚多，追迫領先馬匹。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, switched 600m out but short of room early in home straight, switched in 300m out, strong run against rail to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處轉換跑線，但直路早段空位不足。三百米處向內移入。沿內欄衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Shifted out at start, held up last, ridden along 600m out, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，留居包尾位置。六百米處受催策。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, improved to chase leader 1000m out, challenged leader top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處推進上前，追趕領放馬。直路初挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early stages, stayed on to grab 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。早段搶口。保持走勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began only fairly and crowded, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from gate 12, raced prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made all, kicked 400m out, stayed on well in home straight and soon in command, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 一放到底。四百米處加速。直路上保持佳勢，瞬即控制大局。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Box seat, well placed into home straight, bumped and lost balance 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。三百米處被碰撞，失去平衡。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W2W2W) Allowed to stride on and take narrow lead before halfway, headed 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 獲許展步上前，半程前領先短距離。二百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W3W3W) Sat in front of midfield, raced wide, traveled smoothly, closed off well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊，走勢暢順。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W5W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 500M, showed good response in straight, bumped near 150M, kept on well to the line, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W5W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上對催策反應良佳。接近一百五十米處時發生碰撞。保持佳勢至終點，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, wider turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走更外疊。直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, sat 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, took the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。一百五十米處取得領先，末段保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W4W) Tracked pace, three wide, ridden and quickly lost position turning into home straight, soon well held and eased.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。轉入直路時受催策，但迅速失位。瞬即被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Clean jump, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed very good response in straight, hit the front approaching 50M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘俐落，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近五十米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Clean jump, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide turning in, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line. (2nd last start.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘俐落，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。（上仗跑獲亞軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W5W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(+) (3W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, good headway middle stages against rail, travelled smoothy into home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out, just failed.
Blood in mouth.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(+)(3W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。中段沿欄追前頗多。入直路時走勢暢順。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先，僅敗。
口內有血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, forced to steady top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初被迫收慢。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Crossed to the fence after the jump before settling down towards the rear, had some work to do turning home, closed off best to take 5th
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 躍出後切入內欄，其後居後列。轉直路彎時落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in 2nd half of the field 5-6Ls off leader, responded fairly passing 400M and not able to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。跑過四百米處時對催策反應一般。未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well final 200m, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W4W) 自外檔出閘，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢良佳，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W3W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 450M, 7 lengths or so back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W3W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。趨近四百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時落後約七個馬位。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, hung out in home straight, ran on well and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。早段加速，直路初取得領先。直路上外閃。末段保持佳勢，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Shifted out and bumped at start, raced in touch with leaders, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹，走勢良佳，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Chased the leader, slightly weakened inside 200M, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬。二百米處略為轉弱。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, challenged up rail from 400m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。自四百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。末段保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Jumped well, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W2W) Jumped only fairly, given a quiet ride at the tail of the field 8Ls off pace, had the job ahead 400M but failed to finish off. (Jockey returning to scale 3 lbs over his declared weight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居包尾位置，落後領放馬八個馬位。四百米處落後頗遠，但衝刺乏力。（騎師返回覆磅時超磅三磅。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W2W) Missed the start and lost a considerable amount of ground, at the tail of the field early then made rapid headway from 1100M to join leader, no match for winner's acceleration from 400M but fought on steadily to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W2W) 漏閘，失地甚多。早段居馬群尾列，自千一米處起快速上前，追上領放馬。自四百米處起加速力不及頭馬，但持續力拼，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field, good headway around field to lead over 200m out, challenged 100m out, ran on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。其後繞過馬群，追前甚多。二百米處取得領先。一百米處受挑戰。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W1W) Slowly away, outpaced in rear, never competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，未能跟上步速。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Began only fairly, raced at rear, 10 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。入直路時落後十個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide early, began to improve from the 900M, closed off strongly, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W4W) 早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自九百米處起開始推進。衝刺強勁，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W1W3W) Held up last, outpaced middle stages, still plenty to do 300m out, ran on strongly final 200m to pass plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W1W3W) 留居包尾位置。中段未能跟上步速。三百米處仍落後甚遠。最後二百米以勁勢追前，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 700m out but no response, pulled up from 500m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。七百米處受催策，但毫無反應。自五百米處起收停。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide at rear, 6 lengths back, similar position on turn, showed no response early in straight, eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步不久發生觸碰，居後列，落後六個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎位置相若。直路初對催策毫無反應，最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Waited with in rear, still plenty to do 400m out, strong and sustained run to lead late on, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處仍落後頗遠。持續以勁勢上前，末段取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, angled out top of the Straight, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路初向外移出。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped and unbalanced early on, outpaced in rear, last and struggling on bend, stayed on final 200m and passed several rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 早段與對手互相碰撞及失去平衡，未能跟上步速，居後列。直路彎居包尾位置，掙扎上前。最後二百米保持走勢及超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, good headway on bend, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, strong run to lead on line in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎追前甚多。未能望空直至二百米處。衝刺強勁，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下率先衝線。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (6W2W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, checked 350m out, short of room in home straight, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(6W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。三百五十米處勒避。直路上空位不足。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out near 500M, not enough room early in straight, made good progress after passing 250M, crowded near 150M, kept on well to the line. (Finished 2nd, placed 1st.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近五百米處時向外移出。直路早段空位不足。跑過二百五十米處後追前甚多。接近一百五十米處時受擠迫。保持佳勢至終點。（以第二名衝線，獲升為冠軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 450M, showed limited response early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位，末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W5W5W) From wide draw restrained to race in mid-division, caught racing wide throughout, didn't pick up 400M and failed to get involved in the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W5W5W) 自最外檔出閘，受約束，居中間位置。沿途走外疊。四百米處未能加速。末段未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W1W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W1W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W3W3W4W) Jumped on terms and sat 3 wide with cover near the rear, made up stacks of ground to be the nearest on the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W3W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to maintain position from 550m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自五百五十米處起難以保持位置。大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Crowded and forced to steady at start, outpaced early stages, wide into home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 起步時受擠迫，被迫收慢。早段未能跟上步速。入直路時走外疊。所負甚遠。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Savabeel out of the Fastnet Rock mare Bayrock. Horses by the same sires include Super Unicorn and Good Good. This fellow had eight starts for three wins (a maiden handicap over 1200m, a 3yo+ handicap over 1550m and a 3yo+ handicap over 2100m) and two placings (including a 3yo group one over 2400m). He was given three trials for one win in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and won by a short-head, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 13. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fifth, beaten by 4-3/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 30. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: 「小法寶」(Savabeel)之後，在港同父馬包括「勁好運」及「小飛俠」等駒，生母出自「燈塔島」(Fastnet Rock)。來港前在紐西蘭八戰得三勝兩位，頭馬包括一場1200米從未勝出馬讓磅賽、一場1550米三歲及以上讓賽，及一場2100米三歲及以上讓賽，上名賽事包括一場2400米三歲一級賽。抵港後三次試閘得一勝。10月13日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下以短馬頭位之先勝出。最近10月30日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬4.75個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, followed winner and well placed into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時跟隨頭馬，居好位。其後未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, challenged from top of home straight, headed 150m out, edged left but stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 領放。自直路初起受對手挑戰。一百五十米處被超越。末段向外斜跑，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, pressed on near the 700M, responded reasonably well when asked (See Incident Report).
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。接近七百米處時受催策。末段對催策反應不俗。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to race prominently, challenged leader top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，居前列。直路初挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled mainly in 5th on rail, did not find much room between runners early in straight, kept on same pace under pressure without quickening inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 大多居第五位，走內欄。直路早段在馬匹之間空位不足。最後二百米受催策時保持同速，未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，沿途居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced in mid-division along the fence, couldn't finish off under top weight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內欄。在負頂磅下未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on outer, 6-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自第九檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能望空直至二百米處。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, cleared after passing 250M, finished off very strongly to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段向外移出。跑過二百五十米處後望空。末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W) Reserved in a position behind midfield, picked up in good style 300M, charged home late but couldn't get past winner. Game in defeat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置。三百米處加速良佳。末段衝刺強勁，但未能超越頭馬，在力拼下僅敗。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Pierro out of the Redoute's Choice mare Beauty Option. Horses by the same sire include Perfect Pairing and Happy Hero. This fellow had seven starts for two wins (a maiden over 1600m and a handicap over 2000m) and two placings (including a 3yo group three over 2000m). He was given three trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He made the run and finished second, beaten by 2-1/2Ls, under pressure over 1600m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished seventh, beaten by 7-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1600m on turf in Conghua on October 23. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「比亞路」(Pierro)之後，在港同父馬包括「幸運同行」及「國大合」等駒，生母出自「利得精選」(Redoute's Choice)。來港前在澳洲七戰得兩勝兩位，頭馬包括一場1600米從未勝出馬賽，及一場2000米讓賽，上名賽事包括一場2000米三歲三級賽。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。10月13日出試田草1600米，早段領放，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬2.5個馬位。最近10月23日出試從化草地1600米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第七名，落後頭馬7.25個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Savabeel out of the Pins mare Happily. Horses by the same sire include Super Unicorn and Good Good. This fellow had eight starts for three wins (including a 3yo group three over 1600m and a 3yo listed over 2100m). He was given five trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished eighth, beaten by 5-1/2Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 05. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「小法寶」(Savabeel)之後，在港同父馬包括「勁好運」及「小飛俠」等駒，生母出自Pins。來港前在紐西蘭八戰得三勝，上名賽事包括一場1600米三歲三級賽，及一場2100米三歲表列賽。抵港後試閘五次。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第八名，落後頭馬5.5個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 5-year-old gelding, by Fastnet Rock out of the Teofilo mare Roz. Horses by the same sire include Setanta and Motor. This fellow had thirteen starts for four wins (a maiden over 1400m, a handicap over 1600m, a handicap over 1800m and a handicap over 2000m) and two placings. He was given four trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat near the rear and finished third, beaten by 6-1/2L, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 27. In the latest trial, he sat last and finished eighth, beaten by 11-3/4Ls, under a hold over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 5. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「燈塔島」(Fastnet Rock)之後，在港同父馬包括「駟跑得」及「馬達」等駒，生母出自Teofilo。來港前在澳洲十三戰得四勝兩位，頭馬包括一場1400米從未勝出馬賽、一場1600米讓賽、一場1800米讓賽及一場2000米讓賽。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。10月27日出試田泥1200米，早段居後列，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬6.5個馬位。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段居包尾位置，末段按韁下跑第八名，落後頭馬11.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W1W) Awkward start and lost ground, raced in rear, keen middle stages, under pressure 550m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。中段搶口。五百五十米處受催策。直路上未能跟上步速及被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W5W5W) From wide draw dropped back to the rear 8Ls off the pace early stages, taken wider by rival 1000M before moving closer to midfield home turn, couldn't finish off as well as his rivals final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W5W5W) 自外檔出閘，早段墮居後列，落後領放馬八個馬位。一千米處被對手帶出較外疊。直路彎追近至中間位置。最後四百米衝刺不及對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 500M, finished off strongly, won by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自五百米處起走第二疊，衝刺強勁，以一馬頭位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, showed some response early in straight, no clear run near 200M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。中段落後約六個馬位。直路早段對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時未能望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Began only fairly and bumped, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 lengths back, there to turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，被碰撞，居後列，落後五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped exiting stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, challenged up rail from 300m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5-1/2L back turning in, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個半馬位。末段衝刺良佳，獲得季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Raced very wide without cover throughout, struggled to maintain position on bend, gave ground final 300m.
The jockey's whip was accidentally knocked from his grasp.
runnerrecords.incident_eng: The jockey's whip was accidentally knocked from his grasp.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。
騎師馬鞭被擊中脫手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced in 3rd, 1-1/2L back turning in, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on strongly to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居第三位。入直路時落後一個半馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先，保持勁勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。二百米處望空，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, commenced move 650M, 3 wide turning in, took the lead 300M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。六百五十米處開始上前。入直路時走第三疊，三百米處取得領先，保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout, mid division, pushed along 500m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，沿途走大外疊。五百米處受推策。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Awkward start and lost ground, recovered to settle rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 600m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處移離內欄。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Held up last, short of room top of home straight, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初空位不足。最後二百米自後列追前甚多，走勢悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W6W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W6W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上移出外疊。末段衝刺強勁，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Soon taken well back and waited with, commenced move inside the 400M stalking the eventual winner wide into home straight, ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 瞬即遙居於後，留力候上。四百米處開始上前。入直路時跟隨頭馬，走外疊。末段以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slow to begin, guided to the fence before improving to race in midfield, kept up the chase on leaders in the straight, held ground final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，移入內欄，其後推進至中間位置。直路上保持追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, some late gains but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路早段空位不足。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W4W) Slightly slow out and made contact, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 550M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W4W) 出閘稍慢及與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching 100M, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W6W) Crowded after the start, reserved near last 7Ls off the good pace, brought wide to challenge turning home and made up a lot of ground under top weight to take lead close home. Impressive win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W6W) 起步後受擠迫，留居接近包尾位置，落後步速甚快的領放馬七個馬位。轉直路彎時移出外疊以展開挑戰。在負頂磅下追前甚多，接近終點時取得領先。贏得漂亮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Shared 6th on rail about 3L off pace early, gained closer to just over 2L back in 5th in slackened tempo home bend, switched out for a tight run just inside the 300M gaining 3rd 50M out. (Questioned for his riding in straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 早段並居第六位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎在步速減慢下追近至第五位，落後稍逾兩個馬位。跑過三百米處後向外移出至窄位。最後五十米進佔第三位。（騎師被查詢有關他在直路上的騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) In midfield along the fence, travelled well into straight but had to wait for a run, shifted lane 250M to continue into clear running before seeing it out strongly to win by 1.5L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時走勢良佳，但須等待空位出現。二百五十米處轉換跑線以繼續望空，其後衝刺強勁，以一個半馬位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W2W) Jumped only fairly then settled down midfield along the inside, travelled well turning for home, fought on strongly under top weight to beat the persistent runner up late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。轉直路彎時走勢良佳。負頂磅下以勁勢力拼，末段擊敗緊追不捨的亞軍馬匹掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Settled in mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段以佳勢上前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W3W) Taken back from gate 14, raced 3 wide with cover at rear, wider turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W3W) 自第十四檔出閘，留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走更外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, forced to switch around winner 300m out, ran on strongly to close on leader but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處被迫繞過頭馬轉換跑線。走勢強勁，追近領放馬，但一直落後該駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made good progress to take a place. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後固守內疊，追前甚多，跑獲季軍。（見競賽事件報告。）
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Settled 3-wide in last few after moderate start, commenced move 600M out swinging wider into straight, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish while hanging in.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘普通，居最後數位之內，走第三疊。六百米處開始上前，入直路時移出較外疊。以穩勢上前，內閃，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at tail, 7 lengths or so back, checked near 600M, still last turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後約七個馬位。接近六百米處時勒避。入直路時仍居包尾位置，直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 起步時被碰撞及失去平衡，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑入亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受催策。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W4W6W) Jumped only fairly, raced keenly and refused to settle due to the pace being run outside of standard time, improved his position on outside passing 800M but was left without a finishing effort in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W4W6W) 出閘僅屬一般。由於賽事步速較標準時間為慢，搶口及不願穩定走勢。跑過八百米處時沿外疊追前，但在直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Travelled 3-wide in 8th in rear of midfield, commenced move making home bend swinging widest into straight, ran on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間之後第八位，走第三疊。轉直路彎時開始上前，入直路時移出最外疊。在催策下上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, unable to pick up for pressure from 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自五百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 5 lengths back turning in, not enough room early in straight, cleared 300M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，失去平衡，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初空位不足。三百米處望空。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Settled in midfield 2-wide, responded well early straight when asked, kept chasing to obtain the lead nearing 100M and just held off fast-finishing 2nd for a gutsy win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路初對催策反應良佳。持續追趕對手，接近一百米處時取得領先。末段在奮勇力拼下力拒衝刺強勁的亞軍馬匹僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Jumped on terms, settled down in midfield but got shuffled back from 900M when the pace slackened, couldn't quite finish it off in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，但自九百米處起賽事步速減慢時墮退。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, crowded and checked 700m out, dropped to rear into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。七百米處受擠迫及勒避。入直路時墮居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 500m out for clear run top of home straight, ran on well and just lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處移離內欄，直路初望空。末段走勢良佳，僅失亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。
